basic_details.job_title: THSTI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Clinical Project Manager, Clinical Research Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: BRIC Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI) has announced 2 project-based vacancies for Clinical Project Manager and Clinical Research Officer posts. The notified pay is Rs. 1,50,000 for the Clinical Project Manager and Rs. 1,25,000 for the Clinical Research Officer under advertisement number THS/RN/21/2026. These short-term positions require qualifications such as MBBS, MD/DNB, MDS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BPT, and postgraduate degrees or diplomas depending on the specific post, along with relevant experience where applicable. content_sections.heading: THSTI Clinical Project Manager at a Glance

rows.details: BRIC Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI)
Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council, Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Govt. of India
Placenta Health Project - Adaptive Dose Finding Platform in India
Clinical Project Manager (1 post) & Clinical Research Officer (1 post)
Faridabad (Coordinating centre at THSTI with regular site visits to AIIMS Delhi, GTB Hospital Delhi, or LHMC Delhi)
Scrutiny and shortlisting followed by further selection process

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the posts must meet the essential educational qualifications and experience criteria: Clinical Project Manager: MBBS with MD/DNB (preferably in Obstetrics & Gynaecology/Pediatrics/Community Medicine/related discipline), OR MBBS with a PG Diploma in Obstetrics & Gynaecology/Child Health/Pediatrics/related discipline with at least 1 year of relevant experience in clinical research and/or maternal and child health, OR MBBS/MDS with at least 4 years of relevant experience, OR MBBS with a PG degree in Public Health/Clinical Research/related discipline with at least 2 years of relevant experience. Clinical Research Officer: MBBS with at least 3 years of relevant experience, OR MBBS with a PG degree in Public Health/Clinical Research/related discipline with at least 1 year of relevant experience, OR MDS with at least 3 years of relevant experience, OR BDS/BAMS/BHMS/BPT or equivalent plus a PG degree in Public Health/Clinical Research/related discipline with at least 3 years of relevant experience, OR BDS/BAMS/BHMS/BPT or equivalent with at least 5 years of relevant experience after internship in clinical research and/or maternal and child health. The upper age limit for both the Clinical Project Manager and Clinical Research Officer posts is 45 years as of the closing date of the online application.

rows.relaxation: To the extent of service rendered as on the closing date
Service rendered in defence forces plus 3 years (minimum 6 months attested service required)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly emoluments are Rs. 1,50,000/- for the Clinical Project Manager and Rs. 1,25,000/- for the Clinical Research Officer. These are short-term positions, and extensions are granted subject to the satisfactory performance of the incumbents and the tenure of the project. content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee can be paid using a Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI. Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for THSTI Clinical Project Manager
content_sections.text: Visit the official website of BRIC-THSTI and access the online application link. Complete Step 1 by entering applicant details. Complete Step 2 by uploading scanned copies of passport-size photo, signature, CV, and required PDF certificates (matriculation, intermediate, graduation/diploma, post-graduation, PhD, and experience/caste/disability certificates if applicable). Complete Step 3 by paying the application fee through Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI. Submit the application form in Step 4 and save the auto-generated reference number email and printout of the application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The applications received will be scrutinized and shortlisted. Shortlisted candidates will be processed for further selection as per the institute's guidelines.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for THSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications is 4th November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Are these positions permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: These are short-term positions under the project, and extensions are granted based on satisfactory performance and project tenure without any claim for regularization.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for age relaxations?
faq.answer: Age relaxations apply to SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD categories (10 to 15 years), Central Government servants (up to 5 years), Institute employees (service-rendered basis), and Ex-servicemen as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What documents need to be kept ready before filling out the form?
faq.answer: Candidates must keep a soft copy of their passport-size photo and signature (jpeg/jpg/png format), a comprehensive CV, and PDF copies of their 10th, 12th, graduation/diploma, post-graduation, PhD, experience certificates, and caste/disability certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for SC/ST and women candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC, ST, Women, and PwBD candidates is Rs. 118/-.
